K95 is basically a full-mechanical version of the K90, which had a mix of mechanical keys and rubber dome ones. I think it just comes with white backlighting and has the 18 macro buttons. K95 Platinum is a K95 with some buttons removed (6 instead of 18 macro buttons) and full, per-button RGB.

Despite my displeasure with Logitech's keyboards, their mice and equivalents devices are still top notch IMO. I've gone through 3 M570 trackballs in maybe 6 years, but thanks to cats, alcohol, and travel, they've been through far more abuse than my keyboard ever did.

My main gripe with logitech mice and such is that they restrict what buttons can be reassigned to what functions in their setpoint software. There are several ways to fix/bypass that though, and http://uberoptions.net/start is a pretty easy to use one. You can also just manually edit the .xml files, but that has no documentation, so you have to experiment a bit to know how to change some stuff.
